legacy_reverb.note: output peaks far exceed 1.0, so sf.write to 16-bit PCM hard-clipped every 'reverb' example

legacy_eq.note: iirpeak is a band-PASS resonator, so apply_eq returned the band-passed signal scaled by <1 dB instead of a boost/cut

gain_in_tokens.note: the 48 kHz EnCodec normalizes each chunk and stores level in a separate scale, so tokens barely encode gain
